nodes.n: Third match. An hour before the toss. Vikrant throws his helmet against the lockers so hard a visor cracks.

nodes.t: "Twenty-one is young for a captain." Mehra's offering YOU the captaincy? After everything my family did for him?
Is that why you're so brave, chaiwala? Because you've already got the job?

choice.t: Show him the message. And everything else.
choice.d: No more secrets in this room.

nodes.t: Run away then. You're good at it.

nodes.n: It takes three teammates and Kabir Sir's voice to separate you. Two fines. One split lip. The whole team watching.

nodes.t: The man who wants to break this team doesn't need to do anything. You're doing it for him.

nodes.n: He reads all of it. The texts, the threats, the photo of Veer's school. His hands are shaking when he gives the phone back.

nodes.t: He bought my father. He's not buying me.
...And he's definitely not buying you. You're too cheap, chaiwala.

nodes.n: Imran opens the bowling and takes four wickets in eleven balls. He celebrates every one by pretending to row a boat.
Imran's third over. He lands on his left foot and something cracks so loudly the stump microphone picks it up. He doesn't get up.

moment.title: 14 off 6
moment.desc: Third match. The series is level. Vikrant at the other end, swearing at you and the bowler equally. Fourteen to win.

nodes.n: You're not playing. You carry drinks. Vikrant hits the winning runs and points his bat at the dressing room. At you. You can't tell if it's a joke.
Series lead. Vikrant runs the length of the pitch to hug you, then remembers he's angry and turns it into a shoulder bump.
Two short. The visiting team celebrates. The series goes to a final.
Nets after the match. A throwdown specialist's ball jumps off a damp patch and slams into your bottom hand. You hear it before you feel it.
Your right index finger is turning purple. The final is in five days.

nodes.cliff: A broken finger, a blackmailed captain, and a ball Raghav Mehra has already chosen.
